description: SSEN Transmission TEC – Transmission Entry Capacity Register is a dataset listed in SSEN Transmission Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SSEN Transmission, which is the trading name of Scottish Hydro Electric Transmission plc, Registered in Scotland No. SC213460. A list of SSEN Transmission projects that hold contracts for Transmission Entry Capacity (TEC) with NESO. These include existing and future connection projects and projects that can be directly connected to the National Electricity Transmission System (NETS), or make use of it. T o view or download this data, please register or login. Coverage: north of Scotland (SSEN Transmission network area). The portal files it under Generators. Its keywords are TEC, Generation, Contracted, Connect, Date, Capacity. The portal shows 443 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-ssentransmission-portal.
